_: Copy to <yoursite>.geo.json and edit. Delete the _ comment keys.
name: My Site
_paths: Relative to THIS file. render_dir/basemap_dir may point anywhere; serve_align.py mounts them for the picker.
_basemap: fit = what you read control points against (may be licence-restricted). publish = optional, must be openly licensed.
_render: A straight-down render. px_per_unit is how many render pixels one scene unit spans.
_control: 3 minimum, 5-6 better. Read them with align.html; it writes this array back.
_holdout: A coordinate with NO influence on the fit. Any GPS fix from the site.
_checks: Dotted paths into the extent file, for the physics checks.
_metrics: name -> dotted path. Each is multiplied by m_per_unit into geo.json.
